question: Should both OpenGrep precise-scan workflows permanently fail closed when the pinned installer process exceeds 300 seconds?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but selecting the permanent deadline trades scanner availability on unusually slow networks against bounded third-party installer execution and is covered by the protected security label.

options.title: Approve the 300-second ceiling
options.body: Land the current bounded design after refreshing the branch against main; five minutes is ample for the pinned installer while preventing a stalled subprocess from consuming the full job budget.

options.title: Choose a different install budget
options.body: Request a larger outer deadline or a direct pinned-asset installation design if the security owner expects valid installations to exceed five minutes.

recommendation.title: Approve the 300-second ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the current bounded design after refreshing the branch against main; five minutes is ample for the pinned installer while preventing a stalled subprocess from consuming the full job budget.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the OpenGrep workflows and was explicitly routed into this PR's review timeline.
